project: SP-007 / DOC-2-033: Causal Graphs From Perturbation Shadows
output_contract: evidence-ranked hypotheses as evidence cards / review queue; an inferred edge is never called causal because a graph method emitted it; no treatment advice

qc_and_units.intervention_unit: target gene (independent perturbation); cells are replicates
qc_and_units.primary_cell_filter: ngenes >= 500 AND ncounts >= 1000 AND percent_mito <= 20 AND nperts == 1 AND perturbation not containing '+' (multi-perturbation cells excluded from primary, retained as sensitivity arm)
qc_and_units.ntc: perturbation == 'control', same cell QC; matched to each target's batch composition by stratified sampling within batch
qc_and_units.pseudobulk: sum raw counts per (target x batch stratum); CPM library-size normalize; log1p; response score per (target, gene) = log2 fold-change vs batch-matched NTC pseudobulk
qc_and_units.strata: batch (obs column); cell-state stratum = tercile of core_adjusted_UMI_count computed within controls, applied to all cells; both frozen before outcomes

split.primary: 5-fold by held-out target, frozen seed 20260922; no target contributes cells to more than one fold
sensitivities: TF vs non-TF split by CollecTRI source membership, reported only if each side has >= 50 targets

reference_audit_then_freeze.procedure: quantify coverability: targets present as sources in CollecTRI and/or OmniPath signed; measured genes present as targets; freeze evaluable edge universe E* = {(i,j): i in (targets n reference sources), j in (measured n reference targets), (i,j) in CollecTRI OR OmniPath signed}
reference_audit_then_freeze.floor: if |E*| < 500 edges or < 50 evaluable targets, stop at bounded perturbation-response atlas; no graph claims
reference_audit_then_freeze.rule: absence from an incomplete reference is UNLABELED, never negative; semi-synthetic calibration arm stays fully separate from biological claims

methods.baseline_correlation: Pearson correlation between perturbation-gene expression and response-gene expression across all-condition pseudobulk profiles (observational)
methods.baseline_mean_shift: signed pseudobulk log2FC vs matched NTC (the perturbation-response score itself)
methods.causal_method: DirectLiNGAM (pip lingam, version + wheel sha256 pinned) over pseudobulk log2CPM across perturbation conditions, integrated with interventional scores; final edge ranking = bootstrap-median signed interventional effect with LiNGAM orientation where LiNGAM confidence supports it; combination rule frozen before fitting
methods.prediction_contract: every emitted edge carries direction, sign, magnitude, bootstrap uncertainty; abstain when the 95% target-bootstrap CI spans 0 or |effect| < tau
methods.tau_rule: tau = median(|NTC pseudo-intervention effects|) + 2 * MAD, computed once on NTC pseudo-interventions before any evaluation; frozen value recorded

hard_gates.G1_freeze: QC/cohort/split executed with manifest + hashes before scores
hard_gates.G2_split_integrity: assertion: zero target overlap between train and test folds
hard_gates.G3_reference_universe: audit complete, E* frozen with hash; floor respected
hard_gates.G4_held_target_prediction: held-target intervention-response prediction (AP/AUC against frozen labels) exceeds correlation AND mean-shift baselines, paired target-bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero improvement
hard_gates.G5_direction_and_topk: signed direction recovery on E* above 95th percentile of degree+expression-matched nulls; top-k precision at k in {50,100,200} exceeds matched nulls
hard_gates.G6_controls: shuffled perturbation labels ~ null; NTC pseudo-interventions: no systematic sign, high abstention; permuted strata: no metric inflation; expression-matched null genes: no excess edges; data-leakage assertions pass
hard_gates.G7_sensitivity: guide-level aggregation, multi-pert inclusion, leave-one-batch-out, cell-state strata: no gate-level conclusion reverses
hard_gates.G8_reproducibility: independent rerun reproduces identical sha256 of the raw prediction file
hard_gates.G9_replication: LINCS Level-5 downloaded with SHA512 vs GSE92742_SHA512SUMS; gene-ID mapping (Entrez), modality (bulk trt_sh z-scores), aggregation (MODZ consensus per pert_id across cell lines) and the 706-target overlap frozen BEFORE reading replication performance; K562->LINCS sign-concordance on frozen top-100 response genes vs permutation null; reported separately from same-lab RPE1 support; LINCS access failure -> bounded atlas without transport claims

evidence_cards: per-edge cards in three separate classes: association-only, perturbation-only, reference-discordant; each card links perturbation, response, study, uncertainty, contradictions
commercial_artifact: review queue + evidence cards only; source-level license filter for OmniPath constituents (document excluded constituents); runtime/memory measured; reviewer-time measurement protocol; monitoring + rollback spec
stop_condition: if reference coverability, LINCS Level-5 access, or held-target support fails: stop at a bounded perturbation-response atlas rather than weakening the graph claim
